verdict.rationale: Dagster is not itself an agent but a data orchestration platform, so an official MCP server is a valid axis; Dagster documents a first-party 'Dagster+ MCP server' that lets AI sessions access and act on a Dagster+ deployment, confirmed by both docs and a probe hit. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the MCP server working, and clarity on whether it covers OSS Dagster or only the paid Dagster+ tier.
